title: Scale to 100K–1M MVs: sparse commits + table consolidation
description:
Goal: Support 100K–1M materialized views (segments) with mixed refresh-lag tiers (≈5s / 5min / 1h+) for CDP segment membership.

Execution tracks:
1) Baseline + instrumentation (metrics + simulation harness)
2) Sparse commits prototype (commit only dirty tables / group intersection)
3) Table consolidation spike (physical shard tables for cold tiers)

Runbook: use src/tests/simulation/ harness and add scenarios to validate scaling assumptions.
